primary.access: Public XYZ-compatible raster endpoint; no token, account or billing setup required. CORS response tested with a localhost Origin. This is a rehost of government open data, not Esri World Imagery.
primary.hostingLimit: No long-term availability or SLA verified for the public third-party tile host. Data rights and hosting availability are distinct.

fallback.name: EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016
fallback.role: Requested only for confirmed missing Survey pixels inside the permitted land mask. No global underlay is loaded. Fully outside tiles are rejected before imagery fetches; neighbouring pixels in boundary-tile payloads are clipped out before display.
